title: Landed Costs Allocation
phase: Second-Pass Depth Closure — P1 Core Business

splitting_methods: equal — uniform distribution across move count
by_weight — proportional to product weight * qty
by_volume — proportional to product volume * qty
key_findings.svl_update_path: button_validate -> _create_accounting_entries per adj line -> account.move created and posted -> cost.valuation_adjustment_lines.move_id._set_value() triggers SVL recalculation
key_findings.account_move_generation: Single account.move (type=entry) created per landed cost; debit=stock_valuation account, credit=cost_line expense account; amount prorated by remaining_qty/quantity; only created for real_time valuation products
key_findings.state_guard: _check_can_validate raises UserError if state != 'draft'; done/cancelled records cannot be re-validated
key_findings.mrp_extension: mrp_landed_costs adds target_model='manufacturing' and mrp_production_ids Many2many; _get_targeted_move_ids includes MO finished-goods moves, excludes by-product moves with cost_share=False
key_findings.vendor_bill_link: vendor_bill_id on stock.landed.cost; is_landed_costs_line flag on account.move.line; PO line _prepare_account_move_line propagates flag from product.landed_cost_ok
key_findings.rounding: HALF-UP rounding applied per valuation line; rounding_diff added to last line to ensure exact total match
